
CREATE-EPIC
Create a new epic for organizing work units into high-level initiatives

USAGE
  fspec create-epic <epicId> <title>

ARGUMENTS
  <epicId> (required)
    Epic ID in lowercase-with-hyphens format (e.g., user-management)
  <title> (required)
    Human-readable title for the epic

OPTIONS
  -d, --description <description>
    Optional description providing more context about the epic

EXAMPLES
  1. Create epic with ID and title
  $ fspec create-epic user-management "User Management Features"
  ✓ Created epic user-management
  Title: User Management Features

  2. Create epic with description
  $ fspec create-epic auth "Authentication System" -d "Handles user login and sessions"
  ✓ Created epic auth
  Title: Authentication System
  Description: Handles user login and sessions

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-epics
  fspec show-epic
  fspec create-story
  fspec create-bug
  fspec create-task

NOTES
  • Epic IDs must be lowercase with hyphens (no spaces or special characters)
  • Epics help organize related work units into business initiatives
